def tag_secondary_structure(self, force=False):
        """Tags each `Residue` of the `Polypeptide` with secondary structure.

        Notes
        -----
        DSSP must be available to call. Check by running
        `isambard.external_programs.dssp.test_dssp`. If DSSP is not
        available, please follow instruction here to add it:
        https://github.com/woolfson-group/isambard#external-programs

        For more information on DSSP see [1].

        References
        ----------
        .. [1] Kabsch W, Sander C (1983) "Dictionary of protein
           secondary structure: pattern recognition of hydrogen-bonded
           and geometrical features", Biopolymers, 22, 2577-637.

        Parameters
        ----------
        force : bool, optional
            If `True` the tag will be run even if `Residues` are
            already tagged.
        """
        DSSP, see:
                https://swift.cmbi.ru.nl/gv/dssp/

                Parameters
                ----------
                force : bool
                    If True, will re-tag secondary structure, even if already tagged.

                Returns
                -------
                self : `Polypeptide`
                    The `Polypeptide` with secondary structure tags.

                Raises
                ------
                ValueError
                    If DSSP is not available.

                See Also
                --------
                `isambard.external_programs.dssp.test_dssp`
                """
                if self.secondary_structure_tags is not None and not force:
                    return self

                if not dssp_available:
                    raise ValueError("DSSP is not available on your system. Please install it by running "
                                     "`isambard.external_programs.dssp.install_dssp`.")

                # Generate the DSSP output file.
                dssp_output = dssp_path(self.sequence)
                if not dssp_output:
                    raise ValueError("DSSP was not able to run on your system. Please check that the "
                                     "DSSP binary is installed and available.")

                # Open the DSSP output file and process it.
                with open(dssp_output) as f:
                    dssp_file = f.readlines()

                # Remove the header.
                dssp_file = dssp_file[2:-2]

                # Extract the residue names and DSSP tags.
                residue_names = [line.split()[0].strip() for line in dssp_file]
                secondary_structure_tags = [line.split()[-1].strip() for line in dssp_file]

                # Remove the file.
                os.remove(dssp_output)

                # Tag the residues.
                for residue, tag in zip(self, secondary_structure_tags):
                    residue.secondary_structure = tag

                self.secondary_structure_tags =
